title: Inside NASCAR Magazine May June 1998 Kyle Petty Crazy Kyle Cover Ernie Irvan
conditionDescription: Glossy cover bright with light corner and edge wear; spine tight, pages clean.
descriptionText:
Inside NASCAR Magazine, May/June 1998 issue - "Crazy Kyle": the life and times of NASCAR's standup comic, Kyle Petty, cover story. Plus Ernie Irvan ("I'm not really a bad guy"), Steve Park's Daytona Diary, Dale Jarrett ("Yeah, I've come a long way"), and NASCAR's Motorcycle Gang. Cover price $2.95. Back cover carries the 1998 Winston "No Bull" ad.

Condition: Pre-owned, very good - glossy cover bright with light corner and edge wear, spine tight, pages clean. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
